spots.bio: A bronze mulloway sculpture by Ken Martin at the Yalata roadhouse on the Eyre Highway.
spots.name: Mighty Mulloway Sculpture
spots.note: At the Yalata roadhouse on the Eyre Highway, 150+ km from Ceduna; a roadside icon with no destination around it (the candidate note says Port Lincoln but the judge places it at Yalata). Coordinates to be researched.

spots.bio: Islands off Port Lincoln that are the great white shark cage-diving destination; visited only by boat.
spots.name: Neptune Islands
spots.note: About 58 km offshore and boat-only; including it would balloon Port Lincoln's span (60 km).

spots.bio: A swimming and surfing beach with bluffs and reef, about an hour from Port Lincoln.
spots.name: Greenly Beach
spots.note: Source gives only 'an hour from Port Lincoln'; location unconfirmed, so it cannot be shown to lie in Port Lincoln's or Coffin Bay's span. Coordinates to be researched; re-home if inside either.

spots.bio: A 4WD desert track through Yumbarra and Yellabinna to Goog's Lake, north of Ceduna.
spots.name: Googs Track
spots.note: Long 4WD track north of Ceduna through Yumbarra/Yellabinna, pinned later at the midpoint of the whole route; a separate outback journey outside Ceduna's span.

spots.bio: Giant sand dunes at Fowlers Bay, with Scotts Beach and Mexican Hat and whale and sea lion watching.
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Fowlers Bay Conservation Park (provisional; re-pin with resolve-pin.py)
spots.name: Fowlers Bay Conservation Park
spots.note: About 125 km west of Ceduna, beyond Ceduna's span; the Fowlers Bay village is merged into this park spot.

spots.bio: Southern right whale watching from cliff platforms at the Bunda Cliffs visitor centre.
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Head of the Bight (provisional; re-pin with resolve-pin.py)
spots.name: Head of Bight
spots.note: Nullarbor Bight, over 250 km west of Ceduna and outside every SA destination. The existing Nullarbor Plain destination is the WA plain centred at 127.0E (span 250 km), so these four SA Nullarbor places stand alone rather than form a duplicate destination.

spots.bio: Sea cliffs of the Nullarbor stretching for about 200 km, seen from roadside lookouts.
spots.name: Bunda Cliffs
spots.note: Nullarbor sea cliffs on the SA stretch of the Eyre Highway; same reasoning as Head of Bight.

spots.bio: National park of Nullarbor cliffs, caves and plain.
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Nullarbor National Park (provisional; re-pin with resolve-pin.py)
spots.name: Nullarbor National Park
spots.note: Nullarbor National Park (SA) is far from the existing Nullarbor Plain centre and thin as a park destination, so standalone.

spots.bio: The highway across the Nullarbor from Ceduna to Western Australia.
spots.name: Eyre Highway
spots.note: Long road, pinned later at the midpoint of the SA stretch (Ceduna to the border); not a spot of Ceduna because its draw is the Nullarbor crossing.

spots.bio: A large pink galah at Kimba, beside the halfway-across-Australia sign.
spots.name: Big Galah
spots.note: Kimba (the town is merged into this spot) is about 62 km from Cleve's centre, outside Cleve's span (60 km), and the Kimba area has only three kept spots, so it is not a destination.

spots.bio: Kimba museum with the 1908 Pioneer House, a one-teacher school, a pioneer store and a tractor collection.
spots.name: Kimba Museum
spots.note: Kimba area; same reasoning as Big Galah.

spots.bio: A salt lake and walking trails near Kimba.
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Lake Gilles Conservation Park (provisional; re-pin with resolve-pin.py)
spots.name: Lake Gilles Conservation Park
spots.note: North-east of Kimba, about 80 km from Cleve; same reasoning as Big Galah.
